supportedClaim: Exact 320-state arithmetic proves Y_r=C6,0 mu^r+O(300^r), with C6,0 strictly negative and 402.425429345624<mu<402.4254293456256. Hence |Y_r|/256^r tends to infinity. The complete heat-weighted five-simplex projection is not certified.
